output_list.reason: The function transfer does not check if the balance of the sender is greater than or equal to the value to be transferred. As a result, if the balance of the sender is greater than 2^256 - 1, this function can cause integer overflow. This will cause the amount of UNLB tokens of the sender to be lost. A recommended way to fix this is to add the following check: require(balances[_from] >= _value);
